def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace for text columns
    for col in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].where(df[col].isna(), df[col].astype(str).str.strip())
            df[col] = df[col].replace('', pd.NA)
    # normalize label variants: species case, island spaces
    if 'species' in df.columns:
        # chinstrap -> Chinstrap, also handles any case variant
        df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    # convert text numbers to numeric
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year', 'bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix out_of_range body_mass_g (2500-6500 grams) - correct factor 1000 error e.g. 3650000 -> 3650
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        if mask.any():
            corrected = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
            valid = corrected.between(2500, 6500)
            df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = corrected.where(valid, df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'])
        # drop remaining out_of_range (keep NaN if any)
        df = df[df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500) | df['body_mass_g'].isna()]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # drop missing sex (unknown; do not guess)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    d = d[d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip() != '']
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(d['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    d = d.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    grp = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    grp = grp.dropna()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grp.items()}
